overview_description.description: Zaplar develops software for hotel operations. Its platform combines property management functions such as reservations, front-desk workflows, housekeeping, folios, and billing with booking, point-of-sale, guest messaging, and guest-profile tools. The system also supports operational workflows such as housekeeping scheduling, vendor coordination, and event-related planning. Zaplar's software is designed for hotel teams and connects operational data across departments in a unified system.
